definition.title: Get into the newsletters your buyers already read
definition.description: Finds curated newsletters that run a "tools we like" or link-roundup section your buyers actually read, verifies each one's submission process, and drafts one pitch per newsletter in your voice. Skips newsletters pitched in earlier runs; never submits or emails anything.

pitch_angle.title: What to pitch (optional)
pitch_angle.description: The specific feature, launch or resource worth a mention, and why a reader of that kind of newsletter would care. Leave empty to pitch what the Feature map and growth plan show is newest or most useful.

already_pitched.title: Newsletters pitched outside Tin (optional)
already_pitched.description: Newsletters to skip because you already submitted or were declined. Newsletters drafted in earlier runs are skipped automatically.

tone_notes.title: Voice notes (optional)
tone_notes.description: How the drafted pitches should sound. The project's writing style guide is used when present; these notes win where they differ.

prerequisites.reason: The Feature map supplies the real product detail a pitch cites, and the newest thing to pitch when pitch_angle is empty.
The growth plan says who the business serves and records hard no's such as no cold email.
A captured writing style guide shapes the drafted pitches; tone_notes still win.
